findings.claim: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate reached 7.03% in Freddie Mac's survey of September 24, 2026, up from 6.95% the week before and 6.30% a year earlier.
US existing-home sales fell 2.0% in August 2026 to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 3.98 million.
Unsold inventory hit 1.62 million homes in August 2026, or 4.9 months of supply. NAR's chief economist called that the highest level in over ten years.
Homes that sold in August 2026 had a median of 31 days on market, up from 29 days in July. The median existing-home price was $429,100, up 1.6% year over year.
findings.sourceTitle: Existing home sales slip to 3.98 million in August as rates take a bite (HousingWire)

findings.claim: First-time buyers made up 30% of August 2026 existing-home sales, up from 28% a year earlier. All-cash purchases were 27%.
findings.sourceTitle: Existing home sales slip to 3.98 million in August as rates take a bite (HousingWire)

findings.claim: In the week ending September 19, 2026, active listings were up 5.8% year over year and the median list price was $419,500, down 1.3% from a year earlier, per Realtor.com weekly data.
findings.sourceTitle: Housing Inventory Rises 5.8% as Listing Prices Keep Falling (WRE News)

findings.claim: Listed homes spent a typical 61 days on market in the week ending September 19, 2026, according to Realtor.com weekly data.
findings.sourceTitle: Housing Inventory Rises 5.8% as Listing Prices Keep Falling (WRE News)

findings.claim: Realtor.com named September 27 to October 3, 2026 the best week to buy this year, forecasting 13.3% more active listings than an average week, prices 3.5% below the seasonal peak, and about 64 days on market.
findings.sourceTitle: Realtor.com: September 27th - October 3rd Marks the Best Time to Buy a Home in 2026

findings.claim: Realtor.com expects buyer competition during the September 27 to October 3 week to be 30.1% below its annual peak, so sellers face more choice and less urgency from buyers.
findings.sourceTitle: Realtor.com: September 27th - October 3rd Marks the Best Time to Buy a Home in 2026

findings.claim: 81% of buyers rated listing photos the most useful feature in their online home search, and 52% found the home they bought online.
findings.sourceTitle: How to Maximize Online Visibility for Every Listing (National Association of REALTORS)

findings.claim: 83% of buyers' agents said staging made it easier for a buyer to visualize the property as a future home. The living room was the most staged room (91%), ahead of the primary bedroom (83%).
findings.sourceTitle: 2025 Profile of Home Staging (National Association of REALTORS)
